newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi businessman Prince Al-Waleed plans a real estate project north of Riyadh at a cost of three billion riyals.
- Makkah Construction Company earns 373 million riyals from selling 41 housing units near Islam's holiest shrine in Mecca.
- Riyadh governor opens a 202-million riyal hospital.
- A Saudi construction group to launch a recreation project in Dammam at a cost of 80 million riyals.
- Dammam governor to open number of projects in Jubail city at a cost of three million riyals.
